subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Breaks multi-syllabic words into syllables (re-mem-ber); spells correctly in tests, dictation and written work

show.line: Clap the beats in a word. Ba, na, na. Three claps, three syllables! Long words break into little parts.

rounds.prompt: Clap the beats. Ba, na, na. How many syllables in banana?
Clap the beats in sun. How many syllables?
Clap the beats. Re, mem, ber. How many syllables in remember?
Clap the beats in table. Ta, ble. How many? Say the number.
One, two or three syllables? Sort the pictures.
Which card breaks butterfly into syllables the right way?

hints: Put your hand under your chin. It drops once for each syllable.
Say the word slowly and clap each beat.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will clap the beats in elephant.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! El, e, phant. Three claps.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's clap it together. El, e, phant. Three syllables!

parent_line: Can break a word into syllables by clapping the beats.
